blacklist.heading: PBX blacklist
blacklist.intro: When you block a contact, the server also puts their numbers on the PBX's own blacklist, so the call is refused before it reaches the queue. It dials *30 from an extension of its own, waits for each prompt to finish, keys in the number and # and then 1 to confirm; removing a block dials *31 the same way. Numbers added to the PBX by hand are never removed.
